2026: House Bill (H.B.) 1586, 89th Legislature, Regular Session passed and amended Texas Health and Safety Code §161.0041. DSHS revised the Texas Administrative Code, Title 25, Chapter 97, §97.62 Exclusions from Compliance and §97.64 Required Vaccinations and Exclusions for Students Enrolled in Health-related and Veterinary Courses in Institutions of Higher Education. DSHS now posts a blank immunization exemption affidavit form, stock F11-11755 (PDF) for a person to download, complete, notarize, and submit to their child-care facility, school, or institution of higher education, including students enrolled in health-related or veterinary courses. A person may request DSHS print and mail the form via the United States Postal Service to the requested address.
